rationale: KEEP and ABSORB commands the Quick shell has not bound a handler for yet. The descriptor availability flag is the gate: CommandCatalog::setHandler refuses a declared id, so an unbound KEEP or ABSORB action is a menu entry that does nothing. This list may only shrink. Binding a handler removes its id here with the descriptor flipped to implemented; a new KEEP or ABSORB action that arrives unbound fails scripts/verify-command-catalog.py until it is either bound or deliberately recorded here. An empty list is the epic #231 contract gate.
